page.overview:
Who is Jane Powers?

Jane Powers is the head of public relations of Jurassic Park. She is only seen in the game Jurassic Park: Operation Genesis. She may have been meant to take the place of Ed Regis, who was manager of public relations in the novel.

She will inform the player if one of the visitors leaves unsatisfied. She also announces new park attractions and features to visitors via a loudspeaker. Category:Jurassic Park employees Category:Living characters Category:Female characters Category:Characters Category:Humans
